description: Alternate Generated Power Source at Retail Gasoline Outlets - DAM FuelNY is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. In response to Super-storm Sandy, the “FuelNY” law (AML 16.192-H), gas stations subject to the FuelNY program are required to: (1) install an electrical transfer switch; (2) develop an emergency generator deployment plan; and (3) implement their plan within 24 hours of an energy emergency declaration. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are retail gasoline outlets, transfer switch, alternate generated power source, backup, downstate region. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Agriculture and Markets. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
